messages:
Sophia: Quick idea — run a 'belief-led' landing copy microtest across the three deployment pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private).
Mike: Love it. What's the hypothesis?
Sophia: Hypothesis: framing each page around the single core belief visitors hold (speed for hosted, predictability for dedicated, control for private) will lift CTA click-throughs by >=8%.
Ana: Nice. Can we make the hero variations tiny: one-line belief headline + one evidence bullet? Keep the body unchanged.
Owen: For routing — map each CTA to a different lead path: hosted -> self-serve signup, dedicated -> contact sales form + SSO trigger, private -> request a security review. Use UTM params.
Marcus: Also align a launch post and a short benchmark narrative for hosted page: latency/cost numbers + comparison table.
Sophia: Timeline: quick copy drafts today, AB tests up by Tues, webinar tie-in mid-week to drive qualified traffic.
Mike: Metrics to track: CTA CTR, conversion-to-trial, MQLs by route, average time-to-first-response for sales leads.
Ana: Drafts: Hero A: "Instant LLM inference. No ops." Hero B: "Predictable throughput, backed by SLAs." Hero C: "Keep your data on-prem with enterprise controls." One evidence bullet each.
Owen: Routing sketch (UTM examples):
```
Hosted CTA -> /signup?utm=belief-led-hosted
Dedicated CTA -> /contact-sales?utm=belief-led-dedicated
Private CTA -> /request-security?utm=belief-led-private
```
Marcus: For the webinar, headline idea: "How to get predictable, low-latency LLM inference at scale" — tie to dedicated case study.
Sophia: Draft copy links: https://docs.google.com/xxx (I'll paste later). Keep language engineer-friendly, but reduce jargon in the hero.
Mike: Quick checklist: 1) Two hero variants per page 2) Single evidence bullet 3) Routes wired w/ UTM 4) Analytics events + GA dashboard 5) Launch post + benchmark snapshot + webinar mention
Ana: I'll push the hero drafts in the doc and flag changes. Expect first pass in 2 hours.
Owen: I can wire routing and create the lightweight GA dashboard. Tag me if you want event names.
Marcus: I'll draft the short benchmark narrative for hosted (latency, cost per 1k tokens, comparison to baseline) and a launch post outline for social.
LaunchBot: deploy-checklist: marketing-copies/ux/variantA scheduled for review by Sophia at 2391234578
Sophia: Awesome. Small ask — keep the headline verbs active, and test an alternate CTA copy: "Try hosted now" vs "Start free".
Mike: Noted. We'll capture both. :thumbsup:
Ana: Pinging analytics for tracking naming convention: @Owen do you prefer snake_case or kebab-case for event names?
Owen: kebab-case please. simple.
Marcus: One more: add a tiny scoreboard card on each page showing a one-line benchmark stat (e.g., "<50ms median token latency") — could boost credibility.
Sophia: Love that. Ok team — I'll consolidate and post the two-variant screenshots once Ana uploads. Thanks!
